verdict.rationale: Marlin's own docs say that once a topic is set after a brief scoping exchange, it runs without further human input for up to about eight hours, carrying the research through to a finished report and slides. That is genuine autonomous long-running execution. However, each run is a single on-demand research job, not a user-configurable automation, so only the background-autonomy half of the story is delivered. missing for 10: scheduled or recurring runs, event triggers, user-defined automation workflows, explicit background or notification behavior, independent hands-on corroboration.
